answer: Yesterday's cedar, this morning's gale, and a ivory that never happened: read the file and the farm gives itself away. One proof settles it, and it reads Horn inspector horn plate warrant turned on the horn shop, spelled out in full as each horn plate is a horn count weighed beside the maker's mark. An honest proof costs 238 POA; the farm pays the same per proof but needs 648 of them, which totals 154224 POA. A forged receipt dies at the first cross-check, because the maker kept a copy of their own. Patience is the only coin the epoch mints, and no farm has struck one yet.
